Master Services Agreement between Contoso Cloud Hosting and the Customer. Termination: either party may terminate this agreement for convenience by giving ninety days written notice. The provider may terminate immediately and without refund if the customer breaches the acceptable use clause. Indemnification: the customer shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the provider against any third party claim arising from customer content, without any cap on liability. Limitation of liability: the provider's aggregate liability is capped at the fees paid during the preceding one month. Automatic renewal: the agreement renews automatically for successive thirty six month terms unless the customer cancels in writing at least one hundred eighty days before renewal. Governing law: this contract is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware and disputes are resolved by binding arbitration with a waiver of class action rights. Confidentiality obligations survive termination for five years.
